# Why is your Databricks bill so high?

> Paste your Databricks clusters (kind, DBUs used, autotermination) and get what each costs, scheduled work running on pricier all-purpose compute, clusters that never terminate and long autotermination tails, with the setting to change. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/databricks-cluster-cost-advisor/)
- [Databricks cost: autotermination, Jobs compute and DBU rates](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/databricks-cluster-cost-advisor/databricks-autotermination-and-jobs-compute.html)
